purpose: External reference for paired prompt-optimization and topology ablations
known_limits: Dataset content is loaded by upstream runners and is not vendored here
Original datasets retain their own licenses and contamination policies
No benchmark result is evidence until a complete run is independently reproduced
The upstream benchmark includes multi-agent conditions beyond this package's skill contract boundary

registered_cells.scorer: upstream exact match and token F1

split_policy.development: newly authored or exposed scenarios only
split_policy.calibration: blinded external raters and frozen judge protocol
split_policy.selection: upstream train/validation IDs excluding registered evaluation IDs
split_policy.test: registered evaluation IDs evaluated once after search freeze
